limitations: CPU is app process percentage of one core; frame submissions are not measured display FPS.
Normal interface animation timing, resolution and shader effects are preserved; Low Power finite motion is deliberately limited to 30 Hz.
Mode workload directly dispatches source and native host pointer events; normal workload uses continuous injected pointer position. They must not be merged.
Raw profile and leak-instrumented runs are excluded from timing comparisons.
No reliable idle CPU, RAM or old-native-shell parity improvement established; normal continuous-tilt overall CPU was essentially unchanged.
